findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_translations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_translations, check_duplicate, search_images, list_image_facets, share_findings, propose_collection, start_review_shift, propose_correction, get_locus · Private data: get_book, search_images, submit_feedback, submit_page_review · Public sink: submit_feedback, share_findings, submit_page_review, get_locus · Destructive: start_review_shift, submit_page_review, propose_correction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_translations, check_duplicate, search_images, list_image_facets, share_findings, propose_collection, start_review_shift, propose_correction, get_locus · Private data: get_book, search_images, submit_feedback, submit_page_review · Public sink: submit_feedback, share_findings, submit_page_review, get_locus · Destructive: start_review_shift, submit_page_review, propose_correction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
